settings.languageDesc: Choose the interface language. Takes effect immediately.
settings.themeDesc: Pick a theme, applied live. Each theme comes from a separate theme plugin.
settings.fontDesc: Fonts use the system stack, zero bundling. Theme / font size / font prefs persist across restarts.
settings.sidebarStyleDesc: Choose sidebar layout density and icon style. Applied live.
settings.sidepanelStyleDesc: Choose right panel layout and visual style. Applied live.
settings.pluginOwnDesc: theme-manager's own prefs, stored at ~/.pi-desktop/config/plugins-data/theme-manager/config.json (separate from desktop prefs).
settings.modelsDesc: Manage pi's model providers and models (~/.pi/agent/models.json). Add/edit/remove providers and models; changes save via the top bar.
settings.otherFields: Other fields (parsed from the base .d.ts + actual settings.json, shown with no preset description)
settings.generalDesc: Desktop general config, consumed by internal modules
settings.defaultThinkingLevelDesc: Default thinking level for the chat page, used when user hasn't manually selected one
settings.sidebarDefaultOpenDesc: Whether to expand the left sidebar on app startup, toggle with Cmd/Ctrl+B anytime
settings.skillNextSession: Changes take effect on next session
settings.skillToggleEnable: Enable / disable (writes +/- entries to settings.json, takes effect next session)
settings.skillToggleForce: Pin to context: when pinned, the skill enters the system prompt and the model can invoke it; when unpinned, it can only be triggered manually via /skill
settings.showHiddenMessagesDesc: Show internal context injected by the agent (e.g. CLAUDE.md), off by default
settings.timelineCollapseDefaultDesc: Tool cards (Bash/Edit/Read/Grep/default) and thinking chain in session flow collapse by default, click to expand
settings.timelineThemeDesc: Independent theme for the center conversation area - only affects the center, not the sidebars/titlebar
settings.timelineThemeInheritDesc: Center follows the global theme without override

const sessions = await pi.sessions.list({ cwd });
